text: Design rules for the SIS: de-energise-to-trip; sensors are independent from the control sensors (no shared transmitter); voting by 2oo3 for the safety functions of SIL 2 or higher and for the functions whose spurious trip means a unit trip; separate impulse lines; final elements dedicated to the SIS (no shared valve with control) with partial stroke testing and diagnostics, where possible; the safety response time budget shall be at most 50 % of the process safety time.
